description: Election Commission - Notice declaring Mr. E. Gnananayagam  Gnanagunalan was elected as the member of the ward 02, Puliyanlculam of Trincomalee Town & Gravets, Pradeshiya Sabha - Declaring Mr. N. Rasanayagam was elected as the member of the ward 01, Anbuwalipuram of Tricomalee Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Trincomalee Town & Gravets Pradeshiya Sabha and Trincomalee Urban Council) due to resignations, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of elected members to fill vacant positions, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and candidate declarations for local government positions.
